newsitem.title: PERU: Peru mudslide kills 14 in minivan.
newsitem.headline: Peru mudslide kills 14 in minivan.

text.p: Rescuers pulled two more bodies from the wreck of a minivan swept down a cliff by a mudslide, bringing the death toll to 14 in the latest disaster caused by heavy rains in the Peruvian Andes, local television said early on Tuesday.
The mudslide slammed into the van packed with teachers on a Sunday outing near the mountain town of Abancay, 600 miles (96 km) southeast of Lima.

The mudslide sent the van plunging down a river gorge, where it landed in the river, TV pictures showed. At least two people were pulled alive but injured from the wreckage of the van, television news said.
It was unclear how many more bodies might be trapped in the wreckage. Radio reports were saying up to 35 passengers while police were putting the number at about 20.

At least 300 peasants were killed in the same area last month by mudslides caused by heavy rains in the mountains. Villages along the Vilcanota River in Cuzco region have also suffered serious flooding.
